renderer.name: Cytoscape.js
renderer.loading: Dynamically imported only when a decision graph is opened

traceCoverage: all tactic evaluations, including inactive plans and rejection reasons
selected tactic and attached behavior components
ranked, tied, chosen and rejected action candidates
individual score terms and their owning behavior components
behaviorGuarantees: The graph consumes the existing decision trace and does not run a separate scoring model.
Opening the live preview graph does not save controls, spend actions, roll dice or mutate the combat ledger.
Chat flags retain the compact explanation; the complete last-decision trace remains in memory to avoid enlarging world data.
Exported JSON is serializable and PNG export contains only the currently visible graph.
liveState: All five package folders are installed at 0.45.0. Because this is a code-only update to already discovered modules, reload the browser with Ctrl+F5; the Foundry server does not need to stop.
